parameters.jsonBody: ={ "position": "AI Engineer OR Machine Learning Engineer OR LLM Engineer OR GenAI", "country": "IN", "location": "Bangalore", "maxItemsPerSearch": 15, "saveOnlyUniqueItems": true }

parameters.jsCode: const results=$input.all();const KW=["ai","ml","machine learning","genai","llm","nlp","data scientist","mlops","deep learning","generative","foundation model","ai engineer","ml engineer"];const hasAI=t=>{const l=(t||"").toLowerCase();return KW.some(k=>l.includes(k));};const jobs=[];const seen=new Set();for(const item of results){const job=item.json;const url=job.url||"";const desc=(job.description||"").trim();if(!url||seen.has(url))continue;if(job.isExpired)continue;if(!hasAI(job.positionName||""))continue;if(desc.length<300)continue;seen.add(url);jobs.push({company:job.company||"Unknown",role:job.positionName||"",jd_url:url,jd_text:desc.slice(0,5000),ats_type:"custom",is_manual_required:true,location:job.location||"India",salary_range:job.salary||null,status:"scraped"});}return jobs.map(j=>({json:j}));
